techs.name: Foraging Lore
techs.description: Which native plants can be eaten, and how to find them.

techs.name: Field Survey
techs.description: Maps, packs and radio discipline for leaving the crash site. Unlocks the Expedition Gate.

techs.name: Prefab Shelters
techs.description: Bolt hull panels into proper bunkhouses.

techs.name: Combustion
techs.description: Burn dried fibre for steady power and heat. Unlocks the Fibre Burner.

techs.name: Perimeter Watch
techs.description: Lookouts, flares and fauna drills. Unlocks the Watchtower.

techs.name: Cold-Weather Gear
techs.description: Layered fibre clothing that holds body heat outdoors.

techs.name: Pathfinder Kits
techs.description: Better packs and route-finding for long expeditions.

techs.name: Habitat Engineering
techs.description: Pressure domes with heated private bunks. Unlocks the Habitat Dome.

techs.name: Arc Weapons
techs.description: Repurposed hull emitters that drive back large fauna. Unlocks the Arc Turret.

techs.name: Endurance Conditioning
techs.description: Training and diet adapted to the planet's long days.

techs.name: Shellback Armour
techs.description: Shed shellback plates lashed into vests that turn claws.

techs.name: Spine Nets
techs.description: Spinegrass netting keeps pests off the crops and small raiders out of the stores.

techs.name: Glassrock Edges
techs.description: Flaked glassrock blades for tools and spears, sharper than ship steel.

techs.name: Sunstone Hearths
techs.description: Sunstone slabs warmed by day line the sleeping quarters through the night.

techs.name: Seed Vault Records
techs.description: The ship's crop notes, recovered from the hull's memory.

techs.name: Native Cultivation
techs.description: Train the native food the crew gathers most into orchard rows. Unlocks the Native Orchard.

techs.name: Soil Chemistry
techs.description: Balance the alien soil for ship crops.

techs.name: Preservation
techs.description: Drying, smoking and pickling make better meals.

techs.name: Hydroponics
techs.description: Powered racks that grow food through every season. Unlocks the Hydroponics Bay.

techs.name: Fungal Symbiosis
techs.description: Native fungi that feed crop roots. Locks Gene-Tailored Crops.

techs.name: Gene-Tailored Crops
techs.description: Rewrite ship seeds for this world. Locks Fungal Symbiosis.

techs.name: Rootnet Listening
techs.description: The native flora pass signals through their roots. The colony learns to listen.

techs.name: Biosphere Communion
techs.description: Join the colony to the planet's living network. Capstone of the Rootbound future.

techs.name: Glowfruit Preserves
techs.description: Glowfruit candied in its own syrup keeps for a season and lifts the mood of anyone who eats it.

techs.name: Tuber Beds
techs.description: Raised beds of ember tubers between crop rows; the warm roots quicken everything planted beside them.

techs.name: Reedgrain Milling
techs.description: Hand querns grind reedgrain into flour, and the cooks finally have bread.

techs.name: Salvage Protocols
techs.description: Systematic stripping of the wreck for reusable stock.

techs.name: Smelting
techs.description: Smelt the ore the crew has dug into metal over fibre fire. Unlocks the Smelter.

techs.name: Logistics
techs.description: Pallets, carts and inventory discipline. Unlocks the Warehouse.

techs.name: Power Distribution
techs.description: Cleaner wiring and load balancing for every powered building.

techs.name: Field Laboratory
techs.description: Clean benches and powered instruments. Unlocks the Laboratory.

techs.name: Precision Fabrication
techs.description: Print components from refined metal. Unlocks the Fabricator.

techs.name: Geothermal Tapping
techs.description: Bore into the crust for limitless heat. Unlocks the Geothermal Tap.

techs.name: Automated Assembly
techs.description: Jigs and drones that multiply every crafter. Locks Artisan Guilds.

techs.name: Orbital Mechanics
techs.description: Plot the fleet's last known course from the stars.

techs.name: Deep-Space Beacon
techs.description: Design an array strong enough to call the fleet. Capstone of the Beacon future.

techs.name: Bark Rope
techs.description: Braided barkweave rope for hoists, slings and bundles.

techs.name: Basalt Footings
techs.description: Cut basalt footings let buildings go up faster and stand longer.

techs.name: Copper Wiring
techs.description: Drawn copper wire for workbenches, lamps and the fabricators' fine work.

techs.name: Bloomery Tools
techs.description: Rust iron, hammered into spades, picks and saws for every crew.

techs.name: Engine Autopsy
techs.description: Taking the dormant engine apart, one impossible part at a time.

techs.name: Field Medicine
techs.description: Triage, splints and clean dressings. Unlocks the Infirmary.

techs.name: Herbal Remedies
techs.description: Native plants that dull pain and fever.

techs.name: Sanitation
techs.description: Clean water and waste discipline keep illness away.

techs.name: Pharmacology
techs.description: Synthesise medicine from fibre and metal. Adds medkit printing.

techs.name: Surgery
techs.description: Heated wards and surgical tools. Unlocks the Hospital.

techs.name: Xenobiology
techs.description: Understand native pathogens and fauna.

techs.name: Neural Therapy
techs.description: Treat grief and trauma with care and chemistry.

techs.name: Longevity Studies
techs.description: Slow the toll this world takes on the body.

techs.name: Regenerative Medicine
techs.description: Regrow tissue with xenobiological catalysts.

techs.name: Spore Tinctures
techs.description: Veilcap spores steeped in spirit make a painkiller the infirmary can rely on.

techs.name: Bitter Tonic
techs.description: A daily cup of bitterleaf tea keeps fevers short and sleep deep.

techs.name: Lime Plaster
techs.description: Lime-washed walls keep out drafts and the damp that breeds sickness.

techs.name: Communal Life
techs.description: Shared rituals and a place to unwind. Unlocks the Lounge.

techs.name: Oral History
techs.description: Stories told around the fire bind strangers into a crew.

techs.name: Kinship Customs
techs.description: Partnerships and child-rearing on a new world. Unlocks Family Quarters.

techs.name: Rites of Remembrance
techs.description: Honour the dead so the living can go on. Unlocks the Memorial.

techs.name: Landscaping
techs.description: Beauty is a survival tool. Unlocks the Garden.

techs.name: Civic Assembly
techs.description: A council and the rules to run it. Unlocks the Council Hall.

techs.name: Mediation
techs.description: Structured ways to settle grievances before they fester.

techs.name: Artisan Guilds
techs.description: Craft as identity and pride. Locks Automated Assembly.

techs.name: Shared Purpose
techs.description: A common story of why the colony endures.

techs.name: Colony Charter
techs.description: The founding document of a new people.

techs.name: Sweetpod Wine
techs.description: Fermented sweetpods, shared on rest days. Arguments get louder and friendships stronger.

techs.name: Silk Weaving
techs.description: Silkreed cloth for bedding and shirts: warm, light and a small luxury.

techs.name: Glyph Rubbings
techs.description: Charcoal rubbings of the glyph stones, pored over every evening.

techs.name: Spectral Survey
techs.description: Read the strange light of the planet's minerals.

techs.name: Xenoarchaeology
techs.description: Safely open and study precursor relics. Unlocks the Xeno Lab.

techs.name: Signal Analysis
techs.description: Isolate the alien carrier wave. Unlocks the Signal Mast.

techs.name: Precursor Linguistics
techs.description: The first words of a language older than humanity.

techs.name: Relic Harmonics
techs.description: Relics hum in patterns that point the way.

techs.name: Spire Cartography
techs.description: Map the precursor structure beneath the plain.

techs.name: Resonance Theory
techs.description: Precursor fields can shield as well as sing.

techs.name: Spire Resonance
techs.description: Learn the song that wakes the spire. Capstone of the Ascendant future.

techs.name: Unified Field
techs.description: Precursor physics rewrites human science.

techs.name: Light Threads
techs.description: Glassvine strands carry signal lamps across the colony and far into the dark.

techs.name: Cobalt Lenses
techs.description: Ground cobalt glass makes microscopes and long sights.

techs.name: Quartz Tuning
techs.description: Struck in sequence, singing quartz settles the mind; evenings in the colony are calmer for it.

techs.name: Archive Reading
techs.description: Light passed through the crystal archive projects diagrams no one drew.
